verdict.rationale: Mastra is itself a TypeScript SDK/framework with well-documented official APIs (createTool, createWorkflow, Agent constructor, model router, memory, streaming) and integrates with the official Vercel AI SDK formats, confirmed by first-party docs and community usage reports. missing for 10: independent third-party benchmarking of SDK API stability/versioning and a formal OpenAPI spec (probe found no openapi.json), so slight uncertainty remains on API surface completeness.
